Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat? An aisle seat, please. Okay. Here's your new boarding pass and your baggage claim. Thanks. Go through security and your flight to Stockholm will depart from gate B25. The flight boards at 5.30. Gate B25. Okay. Thank you.
